motions.item_title: Approve the June 18, 2024 Minutes. Board Member Wood seconded the motion
motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to approve the June 18, 2024 Minutes. Board Member Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: June 18 minutes approved
motions.summary: The agency board approved the written record of its June 18, 2024 meeting.
motions.impact: Housekeeping that makes the earlier meeting's record official. It touches the clerk's file and nobody else.

motions.item_title: Approve a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Off…
motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to approve a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Official Project Area Plan for the Triple Tail Community Reinvestment Project Area. Board Member Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Triple Tail project area plan adopted again
motions.summary: On a second vote, the agency adopted the official plan for the Triple Tail Community Reinvestment Project Area, this time with no acreage change attached.
motions.impact: This is the version of the plan that stands. Landowners and developers inside the Triple Tail area deal with it; the record says nothing that changes for people living outside it.

motions.item_title: Reconsider a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the…
motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved to reconsider a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Official Project Area Plan for the Triple Tail Community Reinvestment Project Area. Board Member Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Vote on Triple Tail plan reopened
motions.summary: The agency board reopened its own vote on the Triple Tail project area plan so the plan could be taken up again.
motions.impact: Procedure only. This is the step the board needed before it could vote on the plan a second time, and nothing about it reaches a resident.

motions.item_title: Approve a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Off…
motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to approve a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Official Project Area Plan for the Triple Tail Community Reinvestment Project Area with the following change: 1. Replacing any language stating the project area of 671.49 Acres with 1,170.44 acres. Board Member Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Triple Tail plan adopted with corrected acreage
motions.summary: Board members adopted the official plan for the Triple Tail reinvestment area, again replacing the 671.49-acre figure with 1,170.44 acres.
motions.impact: The board took this vote back later in the same meeting and voted on the plan a second time, so this is not the version that stands.

motions.item_title: Approve a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Off…
motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved to approve a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Official Project Area Budget for the Triple Tail Community Reinvestment Project Area with the following change: 1. Replacing any language stating the project area of 671.49 Acres with 1,170.44 acres. Board Member Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Triple Tail project area budget adopted
motions.summary: The agency adopted the spending plan for the Triple Tail reinvestment area, correcting the area's size from 671.49 acres to 1,170.44 acres.
motions.impact: The corrected figure covers about 499 more acres than the resolution first said. It matters to landowners and builders inside that area; if you live elsewhere in the city, this one passes you by.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Second Amendment to the QTS Participation Agreement.
motions.motion: Board Member Wood moved to approve a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Second Amendment to the QTS Participation Agreement. Board Member Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Second change to the QTS participation agreement
motions.summary: The agency approved a second amendment to its participation agreement with QTS, a deal between the agency and the company.
motions.impact: The record of this vote does not say what the amendment changes, so a resident reading it cannot tell what the agency and QTS agreed to.
